mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND A.${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND A.${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND A.${srchDateGbn} <= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND A.${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND A.${srchNoType} = #{srchNo}
AND CD_TYPE = #{srchCdType}
AND A.${srchEtcType} LIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchEtcContent}, '%')
AND A.LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS04'
mapper.select:
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.ABN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.MRN , A.MSN , A.MBL_NO , A.LAST_POD_DATE
, (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = A.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
, A.LAST_POD_STATUS
, A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.ABN_REQ_DATE , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_CODE , (SELECT BMS_CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_CODE =#{entCode} AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL A
) AA
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL WHERE ABN_NO = #{abnNo}

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT AC.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , AC.MRN , AC.MSN , AC.MBL_NO , AC.LAST_POD_DATE , AC.LAST_POD_STATUS , AC.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , AC.VESSEL_FLIGHT , AC.VOYAGE , AC.AR_DATE , AC.AR_TIME , AC.CHANGE_DATE , AC.CHANGE_COUNT , AC.CHANGE_REASON , CB.ABN_CHANGE_NO , CB.SEQ_NO , CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , CASE WHEN LEN(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) > 15 THEN ( SUBSTRING(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) ) ELSE SUBSTRING(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CB.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) END AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO_DISP , CB.HSN , CB.BL_NO , CB.CHANGE_CLASS , CB.PKG_TYPE , CB.EX_CT , CB.EX_WT , CB.CT , CB.WT , CB.ACCIDENT_CLASS , CB.ACCIDENT_CT , CB.ACCIDENT_WT , CB.REJECT_REASON , CB.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = CB.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , CB.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , CB.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = CB.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , CB.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , IP.OD_JOB_NO , 'Y' AS ABN_YN FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_CHANGE_BL CB LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_CHANGE AC ON AC.ABN_CHANGE_NO = CB.ABN_CHANGE_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN IP WITH (NOLOCK) ON IP.BL_NO = CB.BL_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND AC.AR_DATE = #{arDate} AND CB.ABN_CHANGE_NO = #{abnChangeNo} ) AA
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CHANGE_COUNT),0) FROM TB_BMS_ABNORMAL_CHANGE WHERE CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO = #{customsReportNo}
